joinHint: Enter a room link below, then select Join room.
roomLinkPlaceholder: Paste or type a room link…
connected: Connected. Waiting for the room's track.
connectionFailed: Could not connect. Check your connection and room link, then try again.
invalidRoom: Copy a complete room link ending in /room/NAME, then try again.
protocolRequired: This room needs a newer playback connection. Check that your server supports timeline playback v1.
invalidTimeline: The room's playback data could not be read. Rejoin the room to recover.
unsupportedTimeline: This room's playback format is not supported by this desktop version.
unsupportedSource: This track cannot be played here yet. YouTube tracks are supported.
empty: The room is quiet. Open Add music in a Music room to request a track.
browserFailed: Could not open YouTube. Check that Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is installed.
bridgeFailed: The player lost its connection. Rejoin the room to recover.
commandUnavailable: Playback controls will be ready once the room is synchronized.
commandRejected: The room did not allow that playback action.
autoplay-blocked: Select Enable playback in the video to turn on sound on this device.
unsupported-rate: YouTube does not support this playback speed.
error: YouTube could not play this track. Rejoin the room to retry.
providerError: YouTube could not play this track.
providerTimeout: YouTube took too long to respond. Rejoin the room to retry.
providerDeferred: Waiting for YouTube to start playback…
providerBlocked: YouTube needs permission to play on this device.
localVolume: Volume on this device · Left / Right to adjust
help: Undertone desktop: --server http://localhost:3000 --room NAME [--muted]. Or paste a full /room/NAME URL using the native Join button. --smoke-test starts offline, muted, and exits automatically.
accountExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in or check your account again.
passwordAccountsOnly: Use an Undertone password account. Linked Discord sign-in is not supported here.
accountNeeded: Sign in to manage your own track moods and favorites. Public contributor moods remain visible.
catalogueNeeded: Personal tagging needs a stable catalogue track ID. This track will not be imported automatically.
noContributorMoods: No public contributor moods for this track.
pageFailed: Loading failed. Select Refresh to try again.
pagePartial: Some entries may be unknown. Load more or refresh explicitly.
createMoodHelp: Create a mood with an icon. Creating alone does not tag this track or add a favorite.
createdMoodChoice: Created. Choose Tag track or Favorite explicitly.
preferencesHelp: Your room preferences are separate from your personal track tags. Changes stay in this draft until saved.
musicModeNeeded: Collective Music controls require a Music room and your live room membership. No room mode or queue is changed here.
renewHelp: Keep retains existing content. Renew explicitly asks the server to rebuild the room content using these preferences.
addHelp: Search by title or artist, or paste a track URL. Choose Mix or Next on a result. Nothing is saved to a personal library.
addPermissionNeeded: Your room role cannot add music.
musicSearchEmpty: No results found. Try another title, artist, or URL.
musicSearchLimited: Showing the first 10 results. Refine your search for more specific results.
confirmationHelp: This request conflicts with these room preferences. Review the authoritative names and moods before confirming.
confirmationIncomplete: Conflict details are incomplete. Refresh pending requests before confirming.
refreshPendingHelp: The room changed. Refresh pending requests to recover the current confirmation.
queueRefreshNeeded: Queue page needs a refresh. The public upcoming preview is shown when available.
localSettingsHelp: Volume and mute affect this device. Widget opens a separate floating window with its own pin. Closing the player while the widget is open minimizes the player. Restore player or Quit Undertone from the widget. Room preferences have their own panel.
nativeQueueBusy: The native command queue is busy. Try your action again.
nativeNetwork: The request could not reach the server. Try again explicitly.
nativeAuth: Account validation failed (401). Sign in or check your account again.
nativeRateLimit: Too many requests (429). Wait before retrying.
nativeInvalidResponse: The server response could not be read safely.
nativeInvalidInput: Check the supplied values and try again.
nativeTls: Password sign-in requires HTTPS for remote servers.
nativeBusy: Another native operation is in progress.
nativeStale: The account, track or room changed. Refresh before trying again.
nativeUnavailable: This operation is unavailable with the current membership or permissions.
musicConfirmation: Confirmation required. Open Add music to review it.
musicRevision: The room revision changed. Retry the saved intent or refresh the room explicitly.
musicSlot: The requested upcoming slot changed. Retry or refresh explicitly.
musicRequest: This request conflicts with another request. Refresh pending requests.
musicInvalidConfirmation: That confirmation is no longer valid. Refresh pending requests.
musicNotFound: That request or track is no longer available.
musicUncertain: The outcome is uncertain. Refresh the room or retry the same saved intent explicitly.
nativeOutcomeUnknown: The operation may have completed. Refresh to check its result before retrying.
preferencesAwaitingSync: Saved. Waiting for room preferences to synchronize; refresh the room if needed.
widgetFailed: Could not open the widget. Try again.
widgetPinFailed: Could not change always-on-top. Toggle the pin to try again.
widgetRestoreFailed: Could not restore the player. Use its taskbar button.
widgetMoodsHint: Open track moods to load or manage your tags.
widgetEnablePlayback: Open player → Enable playback to turn on sound
